en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square or street corner. On the right stands a large church or town‑hall‑like building with a tall clock tower featuring an onion‑shaped spire and multiple stacked stages. In the foreground is an open paved area with trees, a decorative streetlamp, and several pedestrians, including children and adults in early 20th‑century clothing. On the left and right sides are rows of two‑ to three‑story townhouses with steep roofs and many windows. The architecture looks Central European, likely German‑speaking. A faint shop sign is visible on one of the buildings, but the resolution makes the text unreadable.
